applications.name: Blood Drive - 1
applications.description: Whenever a Skill Attacker inflicts a Bleed, they also inflict a non-stacking [k=glossary/slow]Slow[/k] Passive lasting 15 seconds. Whenever this Slow prevents an Evade or Unstoppable effect, the Attacker gains a Vicious Passive, increasing the potency of Damage Debuffs by 60% for 15 seconds.

Whenever this Slow prevents an Evade or Unstoppable effect, the Attacker gains a Vicious Passive, increasing the potency of Damage Debuffs by {1}% for {3} seconds.

applications.name: Footloose - 3
applications.description: After activating a Special Attack, the Defender gains an Evade Buff granting a 25% chance to Evade incoming attacks, and an Unstoppable Buff for 7 seconds.

applications.name: Adaptive (Buff)
applications.description: When the Defender is struck, they gain either an indefinite +4% [k=glossary/phys_res]Physical Resistance[/k] or [k=glossary/energy_res]Energy Resistance[/k] Buff. The type of Buff gained cycles every 8 seconds, starting with [k=glossary/phys_res]Physical Resistance[/k], and only one can be gained per cycle.

applications.name: Empyreal Defiance
